services.name: Fishing Charter
services.desc: 3rd party booking fees may apply when booking online. Call or email for other booking options. Backwater fishing (March-December) Flounder, Tautog, Striped bass, Sea Robins, Bluefish, Sheepshead, and Triggerfish are just some of what we may encounter in the famed backbays of Ocean City, New Jersey These trips cater to all skill levels and ages of anglers. Rods, reels, bait and tackle provided. All you need to bring is yourself. Private trips priced Up to 4 anglers More than 4 anglers? We can arrange multi-boat trips with other captains to accommodate your needs upon request. Backwater Striped Bass (Max. 2 Anglers) (March-June, Sept-December) Both DAY AND NIGHTTIME TRIPS AVAILABLE Fishing
